papers.title: VOID: Video Object and Interaction Deletion
papers.summary: VOID is a video object removal framework that performs physically-plausible inpainting in complex interaction scenarios. Unlike existing methods that only correct appearance-level artifacts like shadows, VOID handles downstream physical interactions such as collisions. The system uses a novel paired dataset of counterfactual object removals generated via Kubric and HUMOTO simulators. During inference, a vision-language model identifies affected scene regions, guiding a video diffusion model to generate physically consistent counterfactual outcomes. Open-sourced at github.com/Netflix/void-model.
papers.impact: First open-source framework from Netflix for physics-aware video object removal; advances video editing and VFX pipelines significantly.

papers.title: Embarrassingly Simple Self-Distillation Improves Code Generation
papers.summary: This paper demonstrates that LLMs can improve code generation using only their own raw outputs, without a verifier, teacher model, or reinforcement learning. Simple Self-Distillation (SSD) samples solutions from the model and fine-tunes on those samples with standard supervised fine-tuning. SSD improves Qwen3-30B-Instruct from 42.4% to 55.3% pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, with gains concentrating on harder problems. The method generalizes across Qwen and Llama models at 4B, 8B, and 30B scale, including both instruct and thinking variants.
papers.impact: Provides an embarrassingly simple yet highly effective self-improvement method for code LLMs that requires no external supervision or RL.

papers.title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
papers.summary: CORAL is the first framework for autonomous multi-agent evolution on open-ended problems, replacing rigid control with long-running agents that explore, reflect, and collaborate through shared persistent memory and asynchronous execution. It provides practical safeguards including isolated workspaces, evaluator separation, resource management, and heartbeat-based interventions. Evaluated on diverse mathematical, algorithmic, and systems optimization tasks, CORAL sets new state-of-the-art on 10 tasks, achieving 3-10x higher improvement rates. The framework is fully open-sourced.
papers.impact: Pioneering framework from MIT for autonomous agent self-evolution; major step toward open-ended AI discovery systems.

papers.title: SKILL0: In-Context Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Skill Internalization
papers.summary: SKILL0 addresses the fundamental limitation of inference-time skill augmentation for LLM agents by internalizing skills into model parameters for zero-shot autonomous behavior without runtime retrieval. The framework introduces a training-time curriculum that begins with full skill context and progressively withdraws it. Extensive experiments demonstrate +9.7% improvement on ALFWorld and +6.6% on Search-QA over standard RL baselines, while maintaining an efficient context of fewer than 0.5k tokens per step.
papers.impact: Novel approach to permanently encoding procedural skills into LLM parameters rather than relying on runtime retrieval; implications for efficient agent deployment.

papers.title: Generative World Renderer
papers.summary: This paper introduces a large-scale dynamic dataset curated from visually complex AAA games to bridge the persistent domain gap in generative rendering. Using a novel dual-screen stitched capture method, the authors extracted 4M continuous frames (720p/30 FPS) of synchronized RGB and five G-buffer channels across diverse scenes including adverse weather and motion-blur variants. The dataset advances bidirectional rendering: enabling robust in-the-wild geometry and material decomposition, and facilitating high-fidelity G-buffer-guided video generation. A novel VLM-based assessment protocol measures semantic, spatial, and temporal consistency.
papers.impact: Largest AAA-game-derived rendering dataset (4M frames); enables significant advances in both inverse and forward neural rendering.

papers.title: Steerable Visual Representations
papers.institution: Fundamental AI Lab at UTN / CMU
papers.summary: This paper introduces Steerable Visual Representations, a new class of visual representations whose global and local features can be steered with natural language. Unlike CLIP-style late fusion, the method injects text directly into visual encoder layers via lightweight cross-attention (early fusion). The approach introduces benchmarks for measuring representational steerability and demonstrates that steerable features can focus on any desired objects while preserving underlying representation quality. It matches or outperforms dedicated approaches on anomaly detection and personalized object discrimination with zero-shot generalization.
papers.impact: Introduces a paradigm shift in visual representations by enabling language-based steering of vision transformers; broad applicability to retrieval, detection, and segmentation.

papers.title: The Latent Space: Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, and Outlook
papers.summary: A comprehensive survey examining latent space as a native computational substrate for language-based models. The paper reveals that critical internal processes are more naturally carried out in continuous latent space than in human-readable verbal traces, driven by linguistic redundancy, discretization bottlenecks, sequential inefficiency, and semantic loss. Organized across five perspectives (Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, Outlook), it identifies four mechanism lines (Architecture, Representation, Computation, Optimization) and shows how latent space supports capabilities spanning Reasoning, Planning, Perception, Memory, Collaboration, and Embodiment.
papers.impact: Definitive survey on the emerging paradigm of latent-space computation in LLMs; essential reference for understanding post-token AI architectures.

papers.title: LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross-Modal Reasoning via a Latent-Space Unified Model
papers.institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Tsinghua University / UCSD
papers.summary: LatentUM integrates visual understanding and generation within a shared semantic latent space, eliminating pixel-space mediation for cross-modal reasoning. The unified model enhances interleaved cross-modal reasoning for tasks like visual spatial planning and action-conditioned world modeling. By operating in latent space rather than pixel space, the model achieves reduced redundancy and faster inference. The approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on interleaved understanding-generation benchmarks.
papers.impact: Novel unified architecture from top Chinese universities bridging visual understanding and generation in latent space; advances multimodal reasoning efficiency.

papers.title: Apriel-Reasoner: RL Post-Training for General-Purpose and Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary: Apriel-Reasoner is a 15B-parameter language model trained with a fully reproducible multi-domain reinforcement learning post-training recipe across five domains using public datasets: mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and others. The paper addresses challenges in building general-purpose reasoning models using RL with verifiable rewards, where training recipes and domain mixtures are often not disclosed. Joint optimization across domains poses significant challenges since domains vary in rollout length, problem difficulty, and sample efficiency. The work prioritizes reducing inference cost and latency for practical deployment.
papers.impact: Fully reproducible multi-domain RL training recipe for reasoning LLMs; valuable open contribution for the research community.

papers.title: Omni-SimpleMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory
papers.summary: Omni-SimpleMem is a unified multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents, discovered via an autonomous research pipeline that executes approximately 50 experiments across two benchmarks without human intervention. Starting from a naïve baseline (F1=0.117 on LoCoMo), the pipeline autonomously diagnoses failure modes, proposes architectural modifications, and repairs data pipeline bugs. The framework addresses the critical bottleneck of retaining, organizing, and recalling multimodal experiences over extended time horizons, navigating a vast design space spanning architecture, retrieval strategies, and prompt engineering.
papers.impact: Demonstrates autonomous AI research can discover effective agent memory architectures; pioneering autoresearch-guided system design.

topnews.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 5 with Record-Breaking Benchmarks
topnews.summary: Anthropic officially released Claude Sonnet 5 on April 1, 2026, with model identifier claude-sonnet-5-20260401. The model achieved 92.4% on SWE-bench Verified, surpassing Claude Opus 4.6's 80.8%, and 88.3% on OSWorld-Verified computer use benchmark, exceeding the 72.4% human expert baseline. It ships with a 2M token context window and maintains the same $3/$15 per million token pricing as Sonnet 4.6. Internal testing showed developers preferred Sonnet 5 over Sonnet 4.6 in Claude Code roughly 82% of the time.
highlights: 92.4% on SWE-bench Verified, surpassing previous flagship Opus 4.6 (80.8%)
88.3% on OSWorld-Verified, exceeding 72.4% human expert baseline
2M token context window now out of beta
Same $3/$15 per million token pricing as Sonnet 4.6
82% developer preference over Sonnet 4.6 in Claude Code

topnews.title: Google Launches Gemma 4 Open Models Under Apache 2.0 License
topnews.summary: Google released Gemma 4 on April 2, 2026, its most capable open model family to date, built from the same technology as Gemini 3. The lineup includes E2B and E4B for edge, a 26B Mixture-of-Experts model, and a 31B Dense model that ranks #3 on Arena AI's text leaderboard, outcompeting models 20x its size. For the first time, Google released Gemma under the Apache 2.0 license, a major shift toward true openness. Models support context windows up to 256K, native vision and audio, and 140+ languages.
highlights: 31B Dense model ranks #3 globally on Arena AI text leaderboard
First Gemma release under Apache 2.0 license
Four models: E2B, E4B (edge), 26B MoE, 31B Dense
256K context window with native vision and audio
Available on Google AI Studio, Hugging Face, Kaggle, and Ollama

topnews.title: OpenAI Closes Record $122 Billion Funding Round at $852 Billion Valuation
topnews.summary: OpenAI closed a record-breaking $122 billion funding round on March 31, 2026, reaching a post-money valuation of $852 billion. Amazon invested $50 billion, while Nvidia and SoftBank each contributed $30 billion. OpenAI also raised $3 billion from individual investors through bank channels for the first time. The company is now generating $2 billion in monthly revenue, with enterprise accounting for over 40% of total revenue. The funds will be used for AI chips, data center buildouts, and talent acquisition.
highlights: Amazon invested $50B; Nvidia and SoftBank each invested $30B
$852 billion post-money valuation
$2 billion monthly revenue; enterprise >40% of total
$3B raised from individual investors for the first time
Codex serving 2M+ weekly users, up 5x in three months

topnews.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.1 Ultra with 2M Token Context and Code Execution
topnews.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.1 Ultra featuring a 2-million token context window that works natively across text, image, audio, and video without transcription intermediaries. The model ships with a new sandboxed Code Execution tool that allows it to write, run, and test code mid-conversation. Gemini 3.1 Pro is currently leading 13 of 16 major benchmarks, with a standout 94.3% on GPQA Diamond. The Flash-Lite variant offers 2.5x faster response times at $0.25 per million input tokens.
highlights: 2-million token multimodal context window (text, image, audio, video)
New sandboxed Code Execution tool for mid-conversation coding
Gemini 3.1 Pro leads 13 of 16 major benchmarks
94.3% on GPQA Diamond reasoning benchmark
Flash-Lite variant: 2.5x faster at $0.25/M input tokens

topnews.title: Claude Mythos: Anthropic's Next-Generation Model Leaked
topnews.summary: Details of Anthropic's next-generation model codenamed 'Claude Mythos' were leaked in early April 2026, days after the Claude Code source code incident. The leak revealed Anthropic's plans for a significantly more capable model that could represent a generational leap in AI capabilities. The leak is considered one of the most significant AI model security compromises to date. Anthropic has not officially confirmed the specifications but the leak has intensified competition and speculation across the AI industry.
highlights: Codenamed 'Mythos', represents Anthropic's next-generation flagship
Leak occurred days after the Claude Code source code incident
Considered one of the most significant AI model leaks to date
Intensified speculation about Anthropic's competitive roadmap
⚠️ Exact capabilities and release timeline unconfirmed by Anthropic

topnews.title: Tennessee Becomes First State to Ban AI Chatbots Posing as Mental Health Professionals
topnews.summary: Tennessee Governor Bill Lee signed SB 1580 on April 1, 2026, making Tennessee the first state to enact a standalone prohibition on AI systems representing themselves as qualified mental health professionals. The bill passed unanimously — 32-0 in the Senate and 94-0 in the House. Violations constitute breaches of the Tennessee Consumer Protection Act, carrying a $5,000 civil penalty per violation plus potential injunctions and private rights of action. The law takes effect July 1, 2026, following similar chatbot safety bills passed in Oregon and Washington.
highlights: First standalone state law banning AI from posing as mental health professionals
Passed unanimously: Senate 32-0, House 94-0
$5,000 civil penalty per violation under Consumer Protection Act
Takes effect July 1, 2026
Follows similar bills in Oregon and Washington

topnews.title: Samsung Targets 800 Million Gemini AI-Powered Devices by End of 2026
topnews.summary: Samsung co-CEO TM Roh confirmed the company's goal to double Gemini AI-equipped devices from 400 million in 2025 to 800 million by end of 2026. The expansion covers smartphones, tablets, wearables, TVs, and home appliances as part of Samsung's 'Connect Future' strategy. Consumer awareness of Samsung's 'Galaxy AI' branding surged from 30% to 80% in one year. The initiative gives a major boost to Google in its race against OpenAI and others for consumer AI adoption, as Samsung is the world's largest Android device maker.
highlights: Doubling from 400M (2025) to 800M AI devices by end of 2026
Covers smartphones, tablets, wearables, TVs, and appliances
Galaxy AI awareness surged from 30% to 80% in one year
Part of Samsung's $73B+ AI semiconductor investment plan
Major boost for Google's Gemini consumer adoption

taiwan.title: AI Expo Taiwan 2026 盛大開展，聚焦台灣硬體優勢與全球AI競賽
taiwan.summary: AI Expo Taiwan 2026 於3月25至27日在台北圓山花博園區舉辦，主題為「AI．X 跨域無限」，匯集超過250個品牌、300項AI解決方案與50場以上演講。微軟、AWS、AMD、NVIDIA、IBM、趨勢科技等大廠參展，展示完整AI產業鏈。台北市長蔣萬安於開幕式闡述台北AI未來願景，強調NVIDIA、Google及緯創等供應鏈業者的在地投資承諾。展覽同時聚焦工業4.0與全球工業主權議題，凸顯台灣作為AI驅動生產全球關鍵推動者的角色。

taiwan.title: 台灣推動AI導入傳統製造業，金屬加工、紡織、化工全面升級
taiwan.summary: 台灣經濟部推動將AI技術導入傳統製造業心臟地帶，涵蓋金屬加工、紡織、化學及塑膠等產業。台灣長期以半導體與高科技電子聞名，但工業基礎的大部分仍為傳統製造。此計畫旨在透過AI現代化提升整體工業競爭力，不僅限於晶片領域。政策聚焦流程自動化、決策支援與智慧生產，預期將帶動傳統產業數位轉型新浪潮。

taiwan.title: 台灣AI預算僵局威脅科技政策推進，立法院仍未通過2026年度預算
taiwan.summary: 台灣面臨立法院2026年度預算僵局，恐影響AI與機器人等科技政策議程的推進。儘管2025年台灣經濟成長率高達8.68%，主要受AI相關出口帶動，但預算遲遲未通過可能導致財政癱瘓。政府原規劃的十大AI基礎建設、台南國家雲端運算中心、可信賴AI對話引擎（TAIDE）主權語言模型，以及精準醫療到智慧農業等五大垂直產業應用，均可能受到延宕影響。

taiwan.title: 數位部啟動百億AI新創投資計畫，加速台灣數位經濟發展
taiwan.summary: 數位發展部與國發基金正式啟動「強化AI新創投資計畫」，編列新台幣100億元（約3.2億美元）專項基金，旨在加速台灣數位經濟發展。計畫涵蓋資安、數位轉型、遊戲與生技等多個領域。今年將舉辦六場投資說明會與四場媒合會議，連結AI新創與潛在投資者。首批十家配對投資機構包括台智雲、能源亞洲資本與台安生技等，顯示政府積極扶植AI新創生態系的決心。

taiwan.title: 台積電2026年資本支出上調至560億美元，AI半導體需求年增70%
taiwan.source: 科技新報 / 數位時代
taiwan.summary: 台積電2026年資本支出上調至520至560億美元，較2025年409億美元年增約三成，其中七至八成投入先進製程。董事長魏哲家表示AI需求仍遠大於供給，「AI的擴張才剛開始」。全球CoWoS總需求量2026年預估達115萬片，年增70%，其中NVIDIA佔總需求59%。2奈米製程已於2025年下半年量產且良率良好，2026年將加速放量；矽光子CPO技術預計2026年實現量產，解決AI工廠資料傳輸瓶頸。

taiwan.title: 資策會公布2026年十大AI關鍵技術：AI從虛擬躍入實體世界
taiwan.summary: 資策會發布「2026年十大AI關鍵技術」報告，描繪從虛擬世界的代理人（Agent AI）到實體世界的行動載具（Physical AI）之完整技術藍圖。報告涵蓋LLMOps開發流程優化、負責任AI（Responsible AI）倫理治理，以及能源效率（Energy Efficiency）等面向。資策會指出，2026年進入AI決勝實戰階段，預計超過八成企業將在營運環節部署生成式AI以提升生產力與服務效能，為台灣產業提供策略方向。

taiwan.title: AI代理人2026年轉捩點：台灣硬體強攻AaaS，解鎖兆元商機
taiwan.summary: 科技新報報導指出，2026年為AI代理人（AI Agent）發展的關鍵轉捩點，台灣硬體產業積極布局Agent-as-a-Service（AaaS）模式，有望解鎖兆元級商機。IDC台灣研究團隊指出2026年為「Agentic AI落地應用元年」，未來一至兩年將正式進入「代理經濟」時代。根據調查，台灣企業AI應用前三大領域為流程自動化、決策支援與生產製造，全球代理型AI市場預計從2026年85億美元成長至2030年350億美元。

taiwan.title: 是方電訊揭2026年發展藍圖，Q2推出AI賦能平臺供應用落地
taiwan.summary: 是方電訊於2月26日揭露2026年發展藍圖，宣布轉型為全方位AI、雲端及數據公司，並將擴大AI算力、網路和資安應用服務群聚。公司目標成為東亞地區最重要的數位匯流中心，預計第二季推出「是方AI賦能平臺」，為企業提供AI應用落地的基礎設施服務。此舉反映台灣電信與雲端業者加速布局AI服務生態系的趨勢，呼應台灣從硬體製造走向AI服務創新的產業轉型方向。

taiwan.title: 台南將建AI工廠，聚焦無人機、醫療器材與智慧製造
taiwan.summary: SignalPro宣布投資新台幣30億元（約1億美元）在台南建設先進AI工廠，專注提供關鍵運算力與推論服務。該AI工廠聚焦無人機、醫療器材與智慧製造三大領域，呼應政府推動的台南國家雲端運算中心計畫。此投資案凸顯台灣AI基礎建設正從北部向南部擴展，帶動建設與土地開發商機，同時反映AI工廠熱潮在台灣持續升溫，為南部科技產業注入新動能。

china.title: 中國AI大模型調用量連續三週超越美國，週調用量達7.36萬億Token
china.summary: 截至2026年3月22日，中國AI大模型週調用量已連續三週超越美國，最新一週總調用量達7.359萬億Token，環比增長56.9%，而美國模型調用量僅3.536萬億Token。在OpenRouter全球調用量排名中，中國模型包攬前三名，前九名中佔五席。國產API調用成本僅為海外的1/5至1/20，MiniMax輸入百萬Token收費0.3美元，而Anthropic Claude同性能收費15美元。值得注意的是，OpenRouter平台用戶中美國用戶佔47%，中國僅佔6%，更能客觀反映中國模型的全球吸引力。
china.discussion: 重大產業里程碑，央視、第一財經、36氪等主流媒體廣泛報導

china.title: 阿里雲、百度智能雲同日宣布AI算力漲價，最高漲幅達34%
china.company: 阿里雲 / 百度智能雲
china.summary: 阿里雲和百度智能雲於2026年3月18日同日發布AI算力及存儲產品調價公告，AI算力相關產品上調約5%-34%，文件存儲產品上調約30%，價格調整自4月18日起執行。漲價主因為全球AI應用快速發展導致算力需求持續攀升，核心硬件及基礎設施成本顯著上漲。據知情人士透露，春節期間AI Agent應用爆發，阿里雲MaaS業務百煉創下歷史最高增速，低價補貼時代正式落幕。腾讯雲隨後也加入漲價行列。
china.discussion: 重大行業趨勢，財聯社、界面新聞、中新網等財經媒體廣泛報導，雲計算ETF應聲上漲逾4%

china.title: 中國批准全球首個植入式腦機接口商業化，挑戰Neuralink
china.source: Bloomberg / Scientific American / 南華早報
china.summary: 中國國家藥品監督管理局於3月13日批准了Neuracle Technology（腦虎科技）的植入式腦機接口產品上市，用於因脊髓損傷導致部分癱瘓的成年患者。該系統包括植入式腦電電極，連接氣動機械手套以實現抓取物體功能。這是全球首次批准侵入式腦機接口設備進行商業化使用，標誌著中國在神經科技領域取得重大里程碑，對Elon Musk旗下的Neuralink構成直接挑戰。多家中國腦機接口新創公司已獲得政府的戰略性產業支持。
china.discussion: 全球重大新聞，Bloomberg、Scientific American、南華早報、Euronews等國際媒體廣泛報導

china.title: 字節跳動發布豆包2.0及多模態模型，近2億用戶平台升級為AI Agent
china.summary: 字節跳動在阿里巴巴Qwen 3.5發布前一天推出豆包（Doubao）2.0大語言模型，同時發布Seeddream 5.0圖像生成模型和Seeddance 2.0視頻生成模型。豆包平台已擁有近2億用戶，深度整合進字節跳動的內容和社交生態系統，定位為AI Agent平台。此舉標誌著中國AI競賽進一步白熱化，字節跳動與阿里巴巴在數日內接連發布重磅模型，展開激烈角逐。
china.discussion: 重大發布，與阿里巴巴同期競爭引發行業廣泛關注

china.title: 蘋果國行Apple Intelligence意外上線後緊急撤回，監管審批仍未通過
china.source: 36氪 / 愛范兒 / 觀察者網
china.summary: 2026年3月31日凌晨，中國iPhone用戶意外發現系統設定中出現「Apple Intelligence與Siri」選項，但隨後被緊急撤下。據Bloomberg記者Mark Gurman報導，這是一次意外推送，相關功能技術上已準備數月，但尚未獲得中國監管機構批准。蘋果回應稱因軟體問題導致中國設備短暫下載並啟用了Apple Intelligence，目前已修復。這距離2024年6月WWDC首次發布已過去21個月，國行AI功能何時正式上線仍是未知數。據報導，已下載到本地的模型也被遠端刪除。

china.title: 雷軍宣布小米AI人才專項招聘啟動，2026年AI研發投入達160億元
china.summary: 雷軍於3月30日正式啟動小米集團AI人才專項招聘計劃，宣布2026年在AI領域的研發及資本開支高達160億元人民幣，並表示未來三年將在AI領域投入超過600億元。招聘涵蓋頂尖人才、校園招聘和實習三大通道，崗位覆蓋大模型、智慧手機、智慧汽車、自動駕駛等多個領域。小米MiMo模型由平均年齡僅25歲的核心技術團隊研發，清北畢業生佔比超60%，博士佔比達55%。小米以「高薪+股權+公寓」組合吸引頂尖AI人才。
china.discussion: 重要產業動態，雷軍親自官宣引發廣泛關注

china.title: 可靈AI推出會員模型優惠計劃，3.0系列視頻模型限時8折起
china.summary: 快手旗下可靈AI（Kling AI）於4月1日面向國內用戶推出「會員模型優惠計劃」，活動持續至6月30日，覆蓋Web端與App端。核心優惠方面，鉑金及以上級別的個人與團隊會員可享受可靈3.0系列視頻模型8折靈感值優惠，黃金會員享9折優惠。圖片模型優惠再度延長，低至免費使用。此舉旨在降低高階AI視頻創作門檻，推動AI視頻生成工具的普及化應用。
china.discussion: 行業動態，科技媒體報導

china.title: 中國演員委員會嚴禁未授權使用演員AI影像與聲頻數據
china.company: 中國廣播電視社會組織聯合會演員委員會
china.summary: 中國廣播電視社會組織聯合會演員委員會發布聲明，嚴禁任何主體未經授權擅自使用演員的影像與聲頻數據進行AI訓練或生成內容。這是中國娛樂行業針對AI深度偽造和肖像權侵權問題的首個行業層級規範性文件，反映出AI生成內容快速普及帶來的版權與肖像權保護緊迫性。此聲明與中國更廣泛的AI治理框架相呼應，包括此前發布的AI技術倫理規範草案和AI標註規則。
china.discussion: 熱點話題，涉及AI倫理與版權保護，社交媒體討論活躍

usa.title: Google Releases Gemma 4 Open Source Models Under Apache 2.0
usa.summary: Google released Gemma 4, its most capable open-source model family, under the Apache 2.0 license for the first time. The models are purpose-built for advanced reasoning and agentic workflows with context windows up to 256K tokens, native vision and audio processing, and support for 140+ languages. Available in four sizes (2B, 4B, 26B MoE, and 31B Dense), the models target everything from edge devices to powerful servers. The Gemma ecosystem has surpassed 400 million downloads with over 100,000 community variants.
highlights: First Gemma release under Apache 2.0 license
Four model sizes from 2B to 31B parameters
256K context window with native vision and audio
400M+ total Gemma downloads, 100K+ community variants

usa.title: Microsoft Launches Three In-House MAI Foundation Models
usa.summary: Microsoft unveiled three foundational AI models built entirely in-house: MAI-Transcribe-1 (speech-to-text), MAI-Voice-1 (voice generation), and MAI-Image-2 (image generation). MAI-Transcribe-1 achieves the lowest Word Error Rate on the FLEURS benchmark across 25 languages, beating OpenAI's Whisper and Google's Gemini Flash. The models were developed by Microsoft's MAI Superintelligence team led by Mustafa Suleyman. This marks Microsoft's direct entry into competing with OpenAI and Google in the foundation model space.
highlights: MAI-Transcribe-1 beats Whisper-large-v3 on all 25 languages tested
MAI-Voice-1 generates 60 seconds of audio in one second
MAI-Image-2 debuted #3 on Arena.ai image leaderboard
Developed by Mustafa Suleyman's MAI Superintelligence team

usa.title: SpaceX Acquires xAI in $1.25 Trillion Mega-Merger
usa.summary: SpaceX officially acquired Elon Musk's AI startup xAI, creating the world's most valuable private company at a combined valuation of $1.25 trillion. SpaceX was valued at $1 trillion and xAI at $250 billion. Musk's stated rationale centers on building space-based data centers to address the enormous terrestrial power demands of AI training. xAI was burning approximately $1 billion per month at the time of acquisition. The merged entity is preparing for a potential IPO that could value it at $1.75 trillion.
highlights: Combined valuation of $1.25 trillion, the biggest merger ever
Plans to build data centers in space to address AI power demands
xAI was burning ~$1B per month pre-acquisition
Potential IPO could reach $1.75 trillion valuation

usa.title: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation
usa.summary: The Linux Foundation formed the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), anchored by Anthropic's donation of the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Co-founded by Anthropic, Block, and OpenAI with support from Google, Microsoft, AWS, Cloudflare, and Bloomberg, the AAIF provides vendor-neutral governance for agentic AI standards. MCP has crossed 97 million installs as of March 2026 with 10,000+ published MCP servers. The protocol has become foundational infrastructure with every major AI provider now shipping MCP-compatible tooling.
highlights: MCP crossed 97 million installs by March 2026
Co-founded by Anthropic, Block, and OpenAI
10,000+ published MCP servers in production
Supported by Google, Microsoft, AWS, Cloudflare, Bloomberg

usa.title: Apple Partners with Google to Power Reimagined Siri with Gemini
usa.summary: Apple announced a multi-year collaboration with Google to power a completely reimagined Siri using Gemini models running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute. The new Siri features on-screen context awareness, the ability to chain up to 10 sequential actions from a single request, and enhanced personalization. A privacy buffer layer ensures user data remains isolated from Google's infrastructure. The upgrade is targeting rollout with iOS 26.4, with full capabilities expected at WWDC 2026 and iOS 27.
highlights: Gemini models run on Apple's Private Cloud Compute for privacy
Siri can chain up to 10 sequential actions from one request
On-screen context awareness for reading displayed content
Full rollout expected with iOS 27 later in 2026

usa.title: White House Unveils National AI Legislative Framework
usa.summary: The Trump administration released a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence, outlining legislative recommendations for Congress on federal AI regulation. The framework advocates for a sector-specific regulatory approach using existing agencies rather than creating a new AI rulemaking body. It calls for federal preemption of state AI laws to prevent a regulatory patchwork, prioritizes removing barriers to innovation, and includes provisions for child safety on AI platforms. Democrats have raised concerns about accountability and oversight gaps in the framework.
highlights: Opposes creating a new federal AI regulatory body
Calls for federal preemption of state AI laws
Sector-specific approach using existing regulatory agencies
Democrats concerned about accountability and oversight gaps
Includes child safety provisions for AI platforms

usa.title: Federal Judge Rules Trump Admin Violated Free Speech by Banning Anthropic AI in Government
usa.summary: A U.S. federal judge ruled that the Trump administration violated free-speech protections by banning the use of Anthropic's AI models in government systems. The ruling is connected to a broader Department of Defense lawsuit in which OpenAI and Google employees rushed to Anthropic's defense. The case highlights growing tensions between the administration's AI policy preferences and First Amendment protections. The ruling could have significant implications for how the government selects and restricts AI vendors. ⚠️ Exact ruling date and full details pending primary source confirmation.
highlights: Court found free-speech violation in government AI vendor ban
OpenAI and Google employees publicly defended Anthropic
Connected to broader DOD lawsuit against Anthropic
Implications for government AI procurement policy
